request.query: The set of integer multivariate polynomials with bounded coordinate degrees and bounded coefficients is finite

items.name: Polynomial.card_eq_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_le
items.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ},
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), B₁ i ≤ ↑(p.coeff ↑i) ∧ ↑(p.coeff ↑i) ≤ B₂ i}.ncard =
    ∏ i, (⌊B₂ i⌋ - ⌈B₁ i⌉ + 1).toNat

items.name: Polynomial.card_mahlerMeasure_le_prod
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)

items.name: MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_le_max
items.type:
∀ {σ R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R],
  Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial σ R) ≤ max (max (Cardinal.mk R) (Cardinal.mk σ)) Cardinal.aleph0
